filling: Hey Wolfgang! What are you working on for dinner? It smells really good!
Thanks, Maria! I'm making a stir-fry with some chicken and vegetables. What about you? What did you order?
I ordered a burger and fries. I can't wait to dig in! Do you have any special ingredients you're adding to the stir-fry?

I have tried making stir-fry a couple of times, but it never turns out as good as yours! Do you have any tips for a beginner like me?

Of course! One tip is to make sure your pan is really hot before you add the ingredients. It helps to get that nice sear on the chicken and keeps the vegetables crisp. Also, try to prep everything before you start cooking, so you can work quickly. Do you have a wok or a large skillet?

I usually have some free time on Saturday afternoons. How about we plan for Saturday? That way we can take our time and enjoy making the pizzas!
